title: Harness2 by Google Research – Recursive Agent Harnessing
summary: Harness2 is a research framework from Google Research for building, evaluating, and orchestrating recursive AI agents that can leverage other agents as tools. It provides infrastructure for creating multi-agent systems where agents can delegate tasks to specialized sub-agents, enabling complex hierarchical task decomposition.
problem_solved: Enables researchers to build and benchmark recursive agent systems where AI agents can harness and coordinate other AI agents as tools to solve complex hierarchical tasks.
why_valuable: It provides standardized infrastructure for advancing multi-agent AI research, allowing systematic exploration of agent hierarchies and tool-use patterns at scale.
